reviews.title: Subject: Feature Suggestion – In-App Chat to Check Availability
reviews.text:
Dear Sivi Team,

I’m a user of your app and I really enjoy the experience, especially the opportunity to practice English and meet new people. However, I’ve noticed a small challenge that I think could be improved.

Currently, after having a conversation with a stranger, the only way to check if they are available to chat again is by asking for their personal contact information or using other messaging platforms. I believe this compromises user privacy and can make it difficult to connect at the right times.

I would like to suggest adding an in-app chat feature that allows users to message each other directly within the app. This would enable users to check each other's availability and schedule conversations without needing to exchange personal contact information. It would make the experience smoother, more private, and more convenient for everyone.

Thank you for considering this suggestion. I believe it would make the app even better!

reviews.title: Great app for English Learners
reviews.text: As an IT professional, speaking English is very important, and this app has helped me a lot. I started using this app on Oct 25, 2024, and now I’ve connected with 1,700+ co-learners. At first, I couldn’t speak confidently, but now I can talk with anyone without hesitation. AI Arya Teacher is helpful, and I love that I can practice anytime. App respects privacy and provides a safe space to learn. Mistakes still happens, but that’s part of learning, and talking to people from different places has improved my listening skill too. This app has truly boost my confidence, but the only issue is that it take too much time to connect with co-learners, which can be irritating sometimes. Hope this improve soon! Overall, it’s a great app for English learners. Highly recommended! 😊

reviews.text:

Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Its a scam
reviews.text:
I downloaded your application and made a payment of ₹3, believing that this was the total cost required to access the service. At no point was it clearly mentioned that I would be charged ₹300 as a subscription fee.

I did not use the application after downloading it, and within four days, I uninstalled it. However, despite uninstalling the app and not using any of its features, ₹300 was deducted from my account without my knowledge or authorization.

Nowhere in the application was it clearly and transparently stated that a subscription fee of ₹300 would be charged. The only amount mentioned at the time of payment was ₹3. This lack of clear disclosure is misleading and constitutes an unfair and deceptive practice.

Since I neither used the application’s services nor authorized this deduction, I request an immediate and full refund of ₹300. Kindly process the refund at the earliest and confirm the same.

If the subscription fee is indeed ₹300, it must be clearly stated upfront before any payment is made to avoid misleading users.

reviews.title: Please Fix the Random Co-Learner Connection Problem
reviews.text:
I have been using Sivi for almost 2 years, and it has genuinely helped me improve my English speaking skills and pronunciation. I appreciate the concept of connecting learners for real-time conversation practice.

However, since yesterday, I have been facing a major issue. The app is unable to connect me with any random co-learner, no matter how many times I try. I have waited for several minutes on multiple occasions, but every attempt ends with the same message:

“Uh-oh!! We could not find a Random co-learner for you. Can you please try once again shortly?”

This problem has made the app unusable for speaking practice.

Please investigate and fix this issue as soon as possible. If this is a server-side problem or a temporary bug, it would be helpful to inform users through an in-app notification. I really enjoy using Sivi and hope this issue is resolved soon.

Thank you.

reviews.title: Bad customer service
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this app. I deleted the app without realizing that the subscription needed to be cancelled separately. Despite not using the service, I was still charged ₹299 for the next billing cycle.

When I reinstalled the app, my account appeared as a new account, and I could not access any of the benefits for which I was charged. This made the situation even more frustrating.

I tried contacting customer support multiple times, but there has been no response at all. The lack of support and clarity regarding subscriptions is extremely disappointing.

I strongly suggest the developers improve their customer service and make the subscription cancellation process more transparent. Until then, I would not recommend this app to others.
